relations.rationale: Inspector-heavy visual editors commonly need hierarchy inside the bounded inspector.
When a tool has an explicit target binding, the UI should expose who/where/how-many before mutation.
Discovery can select/focus an object while a separate action pins a tool instance to that object.
A catalog resolves stable tool identity; instantiated tools can then carry independent bindings.
Surface geometry lifecycle and domain target binding are independent state dimensions.
The inspector may be sticky on wide layouts, but sticky behavior is not required by the split composition.
